name: Synthetic fixture: Kepler-186 f (real archive values)

radius_rjup.source: synthetic fixture: real Kepler-186 f value, NASA Exoplanet Archive PSCompPars pl_rade (Torres et al. 2015, 2015ApJ...800...99T), 1.17 Earth radii converted to Jupiter radii (x 6378.1366 km / 71492 km)

teq_K.source: synthetic fixture: real Kepler-186 f value, NASA Exoplanet Archive PSCompPars pl_eqt (Q1_Q17_DR25_KOI_TABLE; the Kepler KOI value, which assumes a Bond albedo of 0.3 and even day-night heat redistribution, not the zero-albedo Teq)

mass_mearth.source: synthetic fixture: real Kepler-186 f value, NASA Exoplanet Archive PSCompPars calculated value (pscp_calc.html), pl_bmasse
mass_mearth.assumption: mass estimated from the planet's radius with the Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relation (archive pl_bmassprov = 'M-R relationship', pscp_calc.html); not a measured mass
